title: Functions as values
hints: A parameter can have a function type, such as f func(int) int. Inside Map you call it like any other function: f(x).
Build a new result slice and append to it. Writing into nums would change the caller's slice, and the tests check for that.
out := make([]int, 0, len(nums)); for _, n := range nums { out = append(out, f(n)) }; return out. Filter is the same loop with if keep(n) around the append.
